description: Keyword-search U.S. bills by title and CRS summary text — the discovery path the Congress.gov API itself lacks (it has no keyword search). Backed by a local full-text index over a bounded window of congresses, which every response names in mirroredCongresses; title and summary are indexed, but policy area and full bill text are not. Returns BM25-ranked matches, each with the bill's derived id (congress/billType/billNumber) for follow-up congressgov_bill_lookup calls and a truncated summary preview. Narrow with the optional congress, billType, and originChamber filters; a congress outside mirroredCongresses returns an empty result with a notice, not a no-match. Searches the local mirror, not the live API — if the mirror has not finished its initial build it returns an empty result with a notice, not an error.

billType.description: Restrict to a bill type (hr, s, hjres, sjres, hconres, sconres, hres, sres).

congress.description: Restrict to a single congress (e.g. 119), one of the mirroredCongresses every response reports. Omit to search the whole mirrored window.

query.description: Free-text keywords matched against bill titles and summaries (e.g. "semiconductor export controls"). Tokens are AND-combined.

name: congressgov_search_bills

data.description: Result rows. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

items.description: Upstream JSON record. Per-tool item shape is rendered in the markdown body.

effectiveQuery.description: The browse scope and applied filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

mirroredCongresses.description: Congress numbers the local mirror holds bills for, ascending — the congresses this tool can search. Empty while the mirror has not finished its initial build.

notice.description: Guidance when results are empty, a page is past the end, or a caveat applies.

pagination.description: Pagination metadata: total count and next offset.

count.description: Total result count across all pages.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page, or null when there are no more pages.

title: Congress.gov Bill Search
